subject: English
question_text: Choose the correct answer from the following alternatives: 1 ✕ 7 =
stimulus: i. How should the father's khaki shirt be ironed to avoid creases? (a) Iron it quickly (b) Iron it carefully and without pressing too hard (c) Iron it so it doesn't have a crease (d) Iron it in the morning ii. Where should okra be grown to avoid red ants? (a) Near the house (b) In the garden (c) Far from the house (d) On the rooftop iii. What should you ensure when growing dasheen? (a) It gets plenty of sunlight (b) It gets enough water (c) It is planted in fertile soil (d) It is planted far from the house iv. How should you behave in the presence of men who don't know you very well? (a) Be loud and confident (b) Be sure to wash every day (c) Smile broadly (d) Avoid talking v. How should you set a table for tea? (a) The same as for lunch (b) Just put cups and plates (c) Set it carefully with tea cups and utensils (d) Only put a tablecloth vi. What should you not do when playing marbles? (a) Squat down (b) Sit on the floor (c) Stand and play (d) Play on the grass vii. What might happen if you pick someone else's flowers? (a) You might get a gift (b) You might catch something (c) You might get praised (d) You might become famous
